correctness.rationale: Exact Gamma monomial moments give the correct kernel. For 0<p<1 and 1<p<2 the two Bernstein integral formulas yield pointwise strictly positive real integrands on |u|<1, and endpoints p=1,2 are direct. For 2<p<4 the Dirichlet-eta limit at -1 is negative, while for p>=4 the alternating tail is bounded by an explicit U(p)<=U(4)=-335/4096<0. Thus all parameter ranges are established without extrapolating from finite computations; numerical checks are supplementary.

value.rationale: The exact zero-free boundary of a canonical continuous family of radial Bergman Hilbert spaces is a natural Lu Qi-Keng invariant. Gamma moments permit a complete real-exponent classification with a stronger analytic half-plane certificate, and the transition separates known integer-Eulerian zeros from the noninteger theory. This is a structural answer, not an arbitrary finite parameter computation or a textbook substitution.
